target_semantics: Predict whether one trial is rated higher than another within the same held-out subject, reducing dependence on global thresholds.
why_may_avoid_archived_failure: Avoids absolute cross-subject rating scale mismatch and does not require MAE/RMSE to validate a weak continuous target.
main_risk: Pair construction can inflate samples or introduce dependence if not carefully grouped by subject/trial.
required_smoke_focus: pair leakage, class balance, trivial baseline, per-subject pair count

main_risk: Too close to archived subject_relative_ordinal_affect_regression_v1; high risk of repeating same failure.
required_smoke_focus: target variance, metric agreement, baseline dominance, fold stability
